members: @Bean TelemetryMeters telemetryMeters(MeterRegistry registry) { return new TelemetryMeters(registry); }
@Bean AuditTrail auditTrail(DatabaseClient client) { return new R2dbcAuditTrail(client); }
@Bean TelemetryHistoryRepository telemetryHistoryRepository(DatabaseClient client) { return new R2dbcTelemetryHistoryRepository(client); }

@Bean IngestPacketService ingestPacketService(TelemetryProperties properties, ValidatedSampleStream stream, AuditTrail auditTrail, TelemetryMeters meters, Clock clock) { return new IngestPacketService(properties, stream, auditTrail, meters, clock); }

@Bean ReorderHistoryService reorderHistoryService(TelemetryHistoryRepository repository, HistoryEventPublisher publisher, AuditTrail auditTrail, TelemetryMeters meters, TelemetryProperties properties, Clock clock) { return new ReorderHistoryService(repository, publisher, auditTrail, meters, properties, clock); }
@Bean PipelineSubscriber pipelineSubscriber(ValidatedSampleStream stream, ReorderHistoryService service) { return new PipelineSubscriber(stream, service); }
